   - Spatial relation: Router's verdict that candles are 'part of the same assembly' rather than 'to the right of' bicycles is visually accurate—the candles emerge from the bike frames.

5. Harshness Bias: I avoided over-penalizing minor issues. The green zebra color (severity 1 texture/color anomaly) only affected tax_score for atom 1, not authenticity_score broadly. The plastic texture is consistent with the 'figurine' interpretation.

6. Atom Score Review: Each atom score was independently justified. For atom 6, both qa_score and tax_score are 0.0 due to count error AND taxonomy failure—this is appropriate given the compound defect.

7. Upward Override Justification: No upward overrides were made. All positive verdicts (atoms 0, 2, 4, 7, 8) were independently verified through visual inspection and supported by at least one expert source. No leniency was granted without evidence.
